body.statement: If \(\mathcal A\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{det}}\) has deterministic limiting rate \(r\in\mathcal R_B\), then \(\mathcal R_-(\mathcal A)\ge L(r)\ge V^*\). The supremum in \(\mathcal R_-\) ranges over the entire local fiber before \(C_v\to\infty\), and the claim does not require regularity or convergence of the terminal policy selector.
body.justification: The theorem supplies the minimax converse against every measurable deterministic-limit annotation procedure.
body.gap: Hirano and Porter do not optimize an observation design, and Nwankwo et al. optimize scalar estimation variance rather than terminal policy regret.
body.consumer: The lower bound certifies that no alternative fixed-limit targeted follow-up scheme can uniformly beat the proposed value.
